transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling really down and persistently depressed lately. It feels like this gloomy, sad mood just won't lift, and I've been struggling with it for about a year and three months now.
Have there been any periods of at least two months during the past year and three months when your mood felt back to normal, or has it been depressed most days the entire time?

No, I haven't had any periods where I felt back to normal at all. It has been continuous and present almost every single day for the entire year and three months. There hasn't been any break from this heavy, sad mood.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Major Depressive Disorder, Persistent Depressive Disorder], but the patient reports a depressed mood that has been continuous for about 1 year and 3 months with no period of normal mood lasting at least 2 months. This chronic, non-remitting course makes Persistent Depressive Disorder more likely and makes Major Depressive Disorder less likely as the primary diagnosis.
